items.title: Sam Most interviewed by Monk Rowe, Los Angeles, California, February 15, 1999
items.q: when I was about 17, you know I was living in New York, so I went down to 52nd Street and they had all these great players there, Art Tatum, Bird, Erroll Garner.

ctx.x: Oh yeah, I wanted to ask you about that.
For about two and a half years, we had Mike Mainieri and a few other people and Buddy. And that went very well. We just traveled around the world because he had a State © Fillius Jazz Archive -9-

Department tour, we went to India and South America and Afghanistan and Vietnam, Nepal, just a lot of crazy places. And he had two records too, but they are kind of collector’s items on different labels. But by the way, just to backtrack, I was at Manhattan School of Music for a while, and that’s when I got the offer to go with Buddy.
